title: THE TOWER · CABLE EMOM · MUNICH
vibe: GREEN · ~50 MIN · RE-ENTRY DAY, LEGS LIGHT, LONG STRETCH
why: Seven days since the last real session and a flight to Munich, so this is a re-entry card: one cable machine, one treadmill, moderate volume, full intensity if you want it. Legs are tired, so the pull of the day is upper body and midline on the cable (five stations on the minute, four rounds), a short interval block, and a long stretch on both ends. Shape is the EMOM, not used since 10-26; the cable movements come from the Tonal bank and today's anti-rotation research.

blocks.title: THE STRETCH · 10 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · Moves Method Day A (shoulders, spine, hamstrings, hips) · slow, breathe out into each position

items.name: Passive hang on the cable frame bar
items.detail: 45 s total, any grip; no bar, hold the two handles at the lowest pulley and sit back into a squat reach

items.name: Shoulder dislocates with the rope or a towel
items.detail: x10, wide grip, slow

items.name: Cat-cow
items.detail: x10, 3 s each way

items.name: Thoracic rotations (quadruped)
items.detail: x8/side

items.name: Single-leg good morning
items.detail: x8/leg, bodyweight, 5 s pause on the last

items.name: Hamstring walkouts
items.detail: x8

items.name: Active pigeon
items.detail: 45 s/side

items.name: 90-90 hip switches
items.detail: x8/side

items.name: Couch stretch on the wall or bench
items.detail: 45 s/side, squeeze the back glute

blocks.title: CABLE EMOM · 20:00 · 5 STATIONS × 4 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 20 SETS · one station per minute · do the reps, rest the remainder · loads in kg, first round finds the weight where the last rep is hard
blocks.workRest: on the minute · 5 stations cycle 4 times

items.name: Min 1 · Half-kneeling single-arm pulldown, start 25 kg
items.detail: x8/side (both sides inside the minute), kneel on the leg opposite the pulling arm, pull the elbow to the hip

items.name: Min 2 · Cable pullthrough, start 30 kg
items.detail: x12, rope at the low pulley, hinge not squat, squeeze the glutes at the top. The only leg loading today

items.name: Min 3 · Face pull to external rotation, start 15 kg
items.detail: x15, rope at face height, pull to the ears then rotate the knuckles to the ceiling

items.name: Min 4 · Inline chop, high to low, start 15 kg
items.detail: x8/side, half-kneeling, pulley high, arms long, turn through the trunk not the arms

items.name: Min 5 · Pallof walkout iso hold, start 10 kg
items.detail: WILDCARD · x3/side: walk out until the cable pulls hard, hold 10 s arms long, walk in. From today's research

blocks.text: Four rounds. GREEN: if every station leaves 20 s or more by round 2, raise the load one plate on the pulldown and pullthrough for rounds 3 and 4. This is a re-entry card: moderate on purpose, go heavy on the pulls if you feel it.

blocks.title: INTERVALS · 4 × 1:00

items.name: Run, 12.5 km/h, 1% incline
items.detail: 1:00, quick cadence, tall. 12.5 km/h is about 7:45 per mile

items.name: Walk, 5 km/h
items.detail: 1:00 on the belt

blocks.text: Legs are tired and you are jet-lagged, so eight minutes, not a 5k. If the first interval feels heavy, drop to 12.0 km/h and keep all four.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 2 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 2 ROUNDS · all on the cable · rest 45 s between rounds

items.name: Half-kneeling lift, low to high, 10 kg
items.detail: x8/side, pulley low, arms long, finish tall over the outside shoulder

items.name: Horizontal pallof hold, 10 kg
items.detail: 20 s/side, feet shoulder width, arms locked straight out, do not let the hips turn

items.name: Kneeling cable crunch, rope, 20 kg
items.detail: x12, rope behind the head, round the spine toward the knees, hips still, 2 s at the bottom

items.name: Straight-arm pulldown, 20 kg
items.detail: x12, standing, rope, ribs down, pull with the lats to the thighs
